import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import './App.css'; function App() { const [rooms, setRooms] = useState([]); const [tierFilter, setTierFilter] = useState('All'); const [view, setView] = useState('guest'); useEffect(() => { fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/rooms') .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => setRooms(data)) .catch(err => console.error(err)); }, []); const filteredRooms = tierFilter === 'All' ? rooms : rooms.filter(room => room.type.toLowerCase() === tierFilter.toLowerCase()); return (

); } export default App;
